entity.attribute.set.summary: Store a namespaced string attribute (group + name + value) on an entity and return the actual owning resource identity.
limitations: Values are strings bounded by the Fusion attribute API; larger payloads must be split. Attributes persist on the next save; this operation does not save. Reusing an existing group/name updates it in place.

inputs.name: Required nonempty attribute name within the group.

entity.attribute.get.summary: Read a namespaced attribute (or every attribute in a group) and return the actual owning resource identity.
limitations: Reads the named group only; other namespaces are not enumerated. The returned resourceIdentity is the actual owning entity reference, not a display-name guess.

inputs.name: Optional attribute name; omit to list the whole group.
